ونستعينه،: And we seek aid from Him,
أن: Indeed, if a person were to perform an obligatory act within it, it would be as if he had performed seventy obligatory acts at other times.
رحمه: May His mercy be upon him.
رضي: May Allāh be pleased with him/her/them.
البحرين،: The two Bahrain(s), or perhaps simply 'Bahrain'.
لرددته،: I will repeat it for you.
يُحَكِّمُوكَ: He will make you a judge
بَطَنَ: To lie in wait or hide
رحمهم: May Allah have mercy on them.
وفتح: And they are eight verses in the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.
وشبهه: And he made it similar to
والتابعين: And those who followed in their footsteps
ولزمه: And he is bound by it
لِّيَدَّبَّرُوا: in order that they may reflect
وَيُخْرِجُهُم: And He will bring them out
يَأتِيَنَّكُم: Indeed, they will come upon you
وَنُصْلِهِ: And we will bring him low
منها: Some of them are questions about Allah Almighty, and Sheikh al-Islam Abu al-Abbas Ahmad ibn Taymiyyah, may Allah have mercy on him, answered them.
خافت: خافت translates to 'She became afraid.' in English.
فرغ: He became free or at ease.
ويحلقوا: And they shall be made to shave
ماجه،: What is that? Or perhaps 'that' or 'it'?
الاقتداء: The act of following or imitating others as a way to learn or behave properly.
أدركني: I have come to know me
((وفي:
((And know that istisqaa has types: The first is supplicating without prayer or behind prayer, and the middle one is supplicating behind the prayers and in Friday sermon, and istisqaa with two rak'ahs and two sermons.
